description: Manages and provides access to various common lookup data, reference values, and master data used across the system, such as currencies, countries, partners, and application types.

endpoints.name: GetCurrencies
endpoints.description: Retrieves a comprehensive list of all available currencies supported by the system.
example_uses: I need to see all the currencies that can be used for transactions.
List all the currency codes and names.
What are the available currency options?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to populate a dropdown or list with currency options, or validate a currency code.

endpoints.name: GetEligibleEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of entities that are considered eligible for specific operations or programs within the system.
example_uses: Show me which entities are eligible for the new program.
I need a list of all eligible organizations.
Can you provide the current list of entities that qualify?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to determine which entities meet the criteria for a particular action or status.

endpoints.name: GetCountries
endpoints.description: Retrieves a complete list of all countries recognized and used within the system, typically including country codes and names.
example_uses: I need a list of all countries for a new user's address.
What are the country options available in the system?
Provide a list of all recognized nations.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to display a list of countries, for example, in address forms, reporting filters, or demographic data collection.

endpoints.name: GetApplicationTypes
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of predefined application types available in the system, categorizing different kinds of applications or requests.
example_uses: What are the different types of applications I can submit?
List all available application categories.
Show me the various application forms.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to present users with a choice of application types when initiating a new application or filtering existing ones.

endpoints.name: GetPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all registered partners associated with the system, including their basic identifying information.
example_uses: I need to see all the partners we are currently working with.
List all registered partner organizations.
Who are our current collaborators?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to display a list of partners, for example, when assigning a task to a partner, generating partner-specific reports, or populating partner selection fields.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationUnits
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all organizational units or departments defined within the system's structure.
example_uses: Show me the different departments in the company.
List all organizational units.
What are the available internal teams?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to populate dropdowns or lists for assigning users to departments, filtering data by organizational structure, or viewing the company's internal hierarchy.

endpoints.name: GetContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all contacts stored in the system, which may include individuals from partners, customers, or internal staff.
example_uses: I need to find a contact person for a specific project.
List all available contacts.
Who are the people I can reach out to?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to search for or display contact information, for example, when assigning a contact to a record, sending communications, or building a contact directory.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all registered users within the system, providing basic user identification details.
example_uses: Show me all the active users in the system.
List everyone who has an account.
Who are the current system users?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to display a list of users, for example, when assigning tasks, managing user permissions, or generating user activity reports.

endpoints.name: GetGeminiModels
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available Gemini AI models that can be utilized by the system for various AI-powered functionalities.
example_uses: What Gemini AI models are currently available for use?
List all supported Gemini models.
Which AI models can I integrate with?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to dynamically fetch and display the list of available Gemini AI models, for example, when configuring AI features or selecting a model for a specific task.
